intuition: The leading candidate after each vote remains the leader until another candidate passes or ties its count.

brute_force.approach: For every query, count all votes up to its time and find the most recent leader.

optimal.approach: Precompute the leader at each vote time and binary-search the last vote not later than the query.

edge_cases: A vote tied for the maximum makes that voter the current leader.
Queries occur at or after the first vote time.
